en:
Got a sec?"

Paul settles his huge body on the floor near the fire, stretching his legs out and relaxing. His clothes are tattered, and he is marred with scratches and dirt, but his eyes sparkle softly in the light, and his woodsman's beard is slashed open with a broad smile.

"This one-on-one thing is like a tradition, right? I come find you and spill all my secrets, talk about my tragic past and then handshake or hug or something and we're friends forever?"

Paul laughs.

|"Well, let's see how I do. I was born on this island, as far as I know. No burn on my neck or nothin', but I never really lived anyplace that had a law to break in the first place. Talking to some of these guys, I'm sure I've done worse than them. Never thought much of it, to be honest. You do what you have to do to get by, right?

It's true though that I've always preferred honest work to hurting people, so maybe that's worth something to ya. I mean, hurting someone is work too, isn't it? Why be the source of all that suffering when you could just lend each other a hand and get a better deal out of the whole works?

I get that you guys don't like this place. It can be a rough ride, sometimes, even if it is my home. 

|I'm having fun with it all, though. I usually just mind my business, do my work, and bugger off. Never really loaned my axe to something so important to so many people, and it feels good to be looked up to for reasons other than just my height, you know?

This might have started as just a little adventure, but I like you, and I hope we can call each other friends. "

Without warning, Paul extends one of his huge arms around you and pulls you close against him in a momentary hug.

"Thanks for having me on.
Great day, isn't it? I mean, it's not so great if you're just looking outside, but look in here. Everybody working together just feels good to me. I'm happy to be here with you.
Well if it isn't my favorite small person! How are you today?
Alright, time for knives!
Shoulda stayed home today, buddy.
Hey, check that out.
Well, lookie here.
That was dirty!
Don't go dyin' on me!
See anything worth nicking?
I don't see nothing.
Well shit, we're done for.
I ain't ready to die!
Nothin' that can't be solved with knives!
Not with me here! Just you watch.
You sure like to complain.

Complain at them hard enough
 and you might kill 'em with that.

Guess we ain't splitting the loot 
with you anymore, eh?

What? Oh, right. 
Revenge and such.

You know, it never occurred to me that I could break into ruins instead of mansions. Always figured the mansions had more loot in 'em, but now I'm not so sure. Better keep looking just to be sure, aye?
Aww, really? Come on, you don't mean that.
Looking for me? What's up?
That's right. You'd be sorry next time you found a lock that needs busting.
Ah, well I guess I don't have to split the take anymore. See you around.
You just saved me so you could kill me yourself? Sick bastard!
You're trying to rob ME? Nice try, but I don't think so.
My turn to eat humble pie I guess. I'm outta here.
You expect me to take orders from you after you kick the shit out of me? Not a chance!

You're insane! Was that your way of 'encouraging' my legs to work again?

 Well, it worked, I'll give you that.
Yeah, good riddance.
We're going to get into all kinds of trouble aren't we? I can hardly wait.

No wonder this place was giving me the creeps. You sat him down good though! I'd have joined in, but he did something to me and my whole body is so numb I can barely even stand up. I felt something snap when you killed him though, and the feeling is starting to come back. I'm sure I'll be good in a minute or two.

You saved my life! Thank you. 

You keep anything you find in here, alright? I'm just happy to be able to walk away from it.
Impressed with my burgling, huh? I told you I was good. Honestly, I could do with someone watching my back on a more long-term basis.
I'll be out of here once I can properly feel my legs again, but if you change your mind before that, come see me.

Hey, wanna hear something funny? It's about the thing that got me sent out here to this rock."

Peregrine sits down beside you, his eyes hidden beneath his bandana and his crooked smile cracking his face practically in half. 

"So I'm a burglar. You know that, and I've never tried to hide it. Not much point, is there? For what it's worth, I never burgled anyone who couldn't stand to be taken down a few pegs. 

Mostly by accident, mind you. Hard-working poor folks ain't got much worth taking, and if you take from someone who has more than he knows what to do with, sometimes he doesn't even notice. Those ones are the best. 

|Anyway, my habit of taking bites out of big fish meant I sometimes pissed off people with some power. A merchant here, a senator there. Most of 'em just went to the guards, and then a little birdie would tell me to lay low for a while, and I would, and in a few weeks it would blow over and I'd be back in business. 

If a guy is a halfway decent burglar, you make enough coin on one job that you don't have to do it very often, so there's lots of time for the trail to cool off. You cut your hair, run some distractions, and you stay ahead of the curve. 

Choose the right targets, and sometimes even the guard doesn't want you to get caught. It's a special kind of warm and fuzzy stealing from someone everybody hates. 

|Well the last job I did before this mess, I hit this one mansion owned by one of the noble houses. The place was all dark, so I thought nobody was home, and I worked my magic and got inside, clean as you please. 

I scrapped together a decent parcel of souvenirs and was getting ready to make my escape when I heard something in the house. 

I probably should have just made my getaway immediately, but the noise was strange, and I was curious. 

|I found a door half-opened, and when I looked inside, there in the romantic candlelight is goddamn Senator Malcolm, up to his eyebrows in the thighs of a strapping orcish manservant. 

I think that orc's haft was the first honest thing that ever passed through old Malkie's lips. 

|I stared just a little too long, and the servant saw me. I ran for it, and I got away, but Malkie went into panic mode, started throwing money around, and all my usual contacts in the guard went silent. 

I think one of 'em sold me out, but it hardly matters. Point is, Malkie was terrified I would tell someone what I saw and ruin his reputation, as if he needed any help. 

|If you went through the court, you know how it is. 

They give you a chance to speak, but it hardly matters, then they brand you and lock you up. 

If you pissed off just the right person, and they want to make extra special sure that you'll never open your yap, then they ship you out here. 

They probably should've cut my tongue, right?"

|Peregrine laughs a bit before standing up. 

"Anyway, that's all. Now if something bad ever happens to me, you'll have to be the one to tell Malkie's wife all about his romantic adventures, aye? Someone's gotta do it.

Maybe it wasn't as funny as I thought, but it felt good to finally tell someone."

Peregrine claps you on the shoulder, and gives you a warm smile and a rare glimpse of his blue eyes.

"Thanks.

Back home, I told folks I was a sailor. I was always worried that my moonlighting would somehow slip out and people would lose their shit. Here, people are almost relieved when they see my brand, like burglary is tame when it comes to the things some of these wackos are here for. All a matter of perspective, I guess.
You gotta be joking. After all that?
Oh hey, I was just thinking about you. What do you need?
That's right, we're buds aren't we? If you need to free up a bed, axe somebody else.
Well I'm certain to steal your thunder at some point so I guess I can't blame you. Don't get yourself killed now.
Yar, I spent enough years movin' cargo on the sly that I got a bit of a knack for it, ye see? Keep me supplied with the coin I needs, and I'll keep bringin' me cargo yer way.
Yer gonna buy er ain't yer?
Yer might not see me for a while, lad. Best be spendin' now.
I got good boots, a strong back, and a big pack. I'm sure you'll find a use for me.
Good day.
Good to go when you are.

I can't issue you any extra supplies or anything, sorry. Got myself pretty busy keeping everyone else around here adequately supplied. If you have anything you want sold or held onto for later though, just leave it here with me. I'll take care of it.
What's our status?
Course. Just come back later if you need anything else.
Well, don't just stand around, buy something if you're gonna, or leave if you ain't.
I got a way with animals, you know.
I gotta get back to my herd, such as it is. I'll be out tomorrow.
I'll show you what I've learned.
You'd better run.
What do you think?
That's gonna cost you!
Okay, no more games!
Looks alright from this angle.

If I die, I'm taking you 
down with me!

Is is today then? 
Bring it on!
You worry too much!

There was a time
I'd have said the same.

If you can't take
the heat, leave!

Shut up! I am trying 
to concentrate!
That could've been avoided.

Now you're right 
where I want you!

Look, I don't care to chum up. I'm along for the ride as long as we keep moving and making progress, but if your plan is to sit around and kick your feet up and get fat, you can count me out. I've had enough of that for a lifetime.
If you don't have the stomach for it anymore, I'll be off.
We going out soon? I could do with stretching my legs.
Then let's get a move on already.
Fine. I can cover better ground alone anyway.
You son of  a bitch.
I don't think so!
Fine. I don't need it.
Serve you? Go to hell.
What a rotten place. Fine, whatever.
Right. Coward.
Alright, let's be off then.

I'll just be on my way, if you don't mind. I took some stuff, but there's a room in the back I haven't touched yet. I'll leave that one to you. Maybe there's treasure, maybe not. Check it out if you want.
Looks like that did it. Good work.
Well... it's not a terrible idea, I admit.
Then don't waste my time.

I know you aren't from Tsarath, so you don't know how things work there, but women have it pretty crappy. There are hardly any of us, and we need to have a lot of kids in order to keep numbers up. They don't force us, not technically, but they keep us out of anything that might get us hurt or killed. 

I always wanted to be a warrior, or an adventurer, but I couldn't get anyone to sell me a sword, let alone teach me to use it.

When the men started courting, as I knew they would, I started thinking that maybe I should just put the dream to rest. Settle down and have kids, live the cushy life I was handed. 

|I even really liked one of them, big mean-looking orc named Nazar. He was everything I wanted to be. Strong, deadly. You should've seen him handle a sword. 

Well, I married him, and he was great. When I asked him to teach me how to use a sword like he did, he was so happy. I think he was excited that I was interested in something he could do. He was a great teacher, too.

For a while, things were good. The sword was a distraction, and I managed to forget that I was still in that gilded cage. Eventually I got restless, though, and decided to go to the military training camp. Nazar begged me not to go, he said I'd get caught, but I had to follow my heart. I took a man's name, put on bulky clothes, and left. 

|For a few weeks it was fine. I was doing well, and the sword techniques Nazar had taught me were getting me noticed. In hindsight, getting noticed was the worst thing that could've happened. One of the sergeants started to suspect that I might be a woman, and he outed me in front of everybody. I was thrown out and sent home.

The next day they came and took Nazar away. I was being tried for identity fraud, and he was my collateral. The trial barely took any time at all, and they found me guilty. I had embarassed them, so they decided to make an example out of my situation, and they sent him here, to Lukatt, and told me to go home and find a new husband. 

I was furious. Nazar had nothing to do with it, he didn't deserve to be punished for what I had done, but there was nothing I could do. 

|Within a year I had remarried. The new man I picked was a foppish thing I chose because I thought he couldn't be bothered to lay with me. He often had men stay the night with him, and I would sleep alone and dream of coming here to find Nazar and set him free so we could be together again. 

Well a few months ago, the opportunity came up. There was an orc man who had been posing as a woman and having illicit encounters with some of the noble merchants. When he was found out, it came crashing down on him hard, and he was all lined up to be shipped out here too. 

I pulled a few strings and made a switch. He actually does look a lot like a woman, so this time passing was easy. 

He went to my estate and presumably lives like a pampered lady with my husband, and I came here in tatters to find the husband I never forgot.

|Whether all that is worth it... I don't know. I came here looking for either a reunion or for closure. Still sorting it all out.

I have you to thank for the opportunity.

Now, go rest. It's another busy day tomorrow.

Never thought I'd be part of a team like this, you know? Feels good, everybody working together toward something greater. This is everything that life ought to be. I'm not at all sad to have left that pampered life behind.
Are you sure you can hold this together without me?
You're right, I'm too important to be without.
Alright, then I'll make my way alone. Maybe I'll see you again.
This is for you!
That is mine!

Do you want to 
do it, or shall I?

I'll nurse you
back to health.
Now I'm angry!

I love watching 
you move.

You look tired.
Rest in my lap awhile.

Today I shall well
earn my fare!

Shall we die
together?

I am... 
quite well-motivated.

My body is your shield!
Treasure it!

I thought you
liked the violence.

Stupid. 
Beautiful, but stupid.
Wasteful.

Well, you left a
beautiful corpse.
You need me for something? Take me to your tent, or someplace private, and remind me again why I am so eager to be useful.
You've lost your appetite for me so soon? Have I not attended your needs as well?
I cannot take my eyes off of you.
You would soon crave me once more were I to leave. Consider that.
I'll not be starved within arms' reach of the feast. See how you fare without me.
That ferocity, that passion! I need you.
A bandit, are you? How disappointing.
Yes, of course. A little something to remember me by.
Wonderful! Prove that you're strong enough to bend me!
Magnificent! I am yours entirely.
Without so much as an embrace? Ah well.
My body trembles with want of you. Do not keep it waiting long.
A brave one are you? Oh, I could think of all sorts of fun to have with a brave one. Maybe you and I should go someplace a little warmer and a little wetter.
Well, well. Look what we have here.
Now you're speaking my language. Let me make this clear though - if you get me, then I get you. Where and when I want.
I don't work without compensation. It isn't negotiable.

A moment first, if you please. 

You have boldly met each of my expectations, and you have been a bottomless draught of pleasure. I am fortunate to have met you.

I thought long and hard on how to best show my appreciation for this, and perhaps it is trite, but I have wrought you a gift. It is simple, but it is a token of my affection, and indeed of my loyalty.

Now, lay with me near the fire awhile. Tonight, I've the greatest of need for you.

Have you considered what you will do when all your battles are won? Will I still have a means to vie for your attention once this is done? I find myself rather distressed at the thought of it. Ah, pay me no mind.
I understand. I am an addiction for you, as you are for me. If you truly wish to reach your goals, perhaps it would be better for us to find each other once this is finished.
Everything about you is perfect.
I am relieved. I do not know if I could tolerate being without you.
If you live, I will find you once this is all over. I will have you again.
Ugh, what a pain.
We got it.
What about it?
This is not okay!
We're losing people!
Hmm? Oh, don't mind me.
Did you say something?
Last dance, I guess.
Oh, shit. This isn't good.
That's absurd. Just pull your socks up.
I think we'll be fine.
Is that all? Don't be such a wimp.
Thanks for the vote of confidence.
Saw that coming.
What a shock.
Well this is more interesting than I thought it would be. Not really sure what we're going to do with this momentum, but it's better than starving alone in a cave!
Aww, really?
Oh hey. Nothing happening right now.
Come on, don't be a shithead.
Well that's no fun.
What the hell is wrong with you?
What? I worked for this too, go to hell!
So you just had to have it all? Fine. I hope it was worth it.
I don't take orders from anybody!

So it's that, or die? Curse this island full of psychos.

Fine.
Thank God.

Wait, you were serious? Oh, well... this is awkward. 

You know, though, you were really steady back there. Maybe it wouldn't be such a bad idea to hang around you for a while. I'm in!

So they feed us nothing but this bland crap day in and day out. We could go hunting or something, but nooo, that would be too exciting. They bore you to tears on purpose so that any activity they give you seems exciting. People were always way excited to get called to the fathers' cabin. I wonder how much ass they were getting?
Not a whole lot here, really. Nothing exciting at least.
Hah, oh sure. We'll just drift around, pissing off cults the isle over. Particularly if they're based around angry dragons.
No kidding. I've had enough dragon cults for ... well for a while. A month, at least.
